decision: I chose sqlite_index. ADR 0008 in mira-app says report data is never cached only in process memory, so in_memory_lru would conflict with it. It would also use the kiosk's scarce RAM. I recorded Mira's 50 MB limit as a new ruling and noted in the app ADR that the cache, including its index, must stay within it.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024, status Accepted, decision key report-cache-limit. It quotes Mira's words: the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM and the report cache must never grow past 50 MB.

New ADR 0024 in mira-app. It chooses sqlite_index over in_memory_lru, citing ADR 0008 (SQLite file, never memory-only), ADR 0007 (24-hour expiry) and ADR 0022 (open in under three seconds). It also requires the cache, including its index, to stay within 50 MB per mira-decisions ADR 0024. Nothing is implemented yet.
